title: Compare an arbitrary positive uniformizer reduction with the finite Cartier class
statement: Assume the completed diagonal reduction, completion, cycle-system and limit-arrow specifications on Y, and a Family with a Reference to that completed arrow [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Fix a finite field E, a uniformizer pi and n≥0. Supply finiteness of the lifted residue ring, the explicit annihilation by ell^(n+1), invertibility of this exponent on Y,W, and kernel-normalized FiniteRoots on P,W. Then there exist a quotient Diagram d, its ScalarCompatibility with family.integral E, and QuotientCompatibility of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotients]: finite realizations, root-projection-normalized line identifications and the canonical Cartier class and unit/Chern trace. No construction of a non-torsion Family and no geometric base-change square is asserted.

source.place: paragraph (1), every positive uniformizer quotient and its finite trace

proof.text: Apply diagonalUniformizer_scalarFrame to family.integral E. This supplies adjoint-normalized scalar endpoints, unit-normalized restriction squares with invertible shifted-line mates, and the two normalized supported-source squares, independently of the class and traces.

Define the quotient diagonal as supported.iso.inv followed by derived scalar extension of the integral diagonal and lineW.shift. Define each quotient trace as the inverse scalar/direct-image comparison followed by scalar extension of the integral trace and the unit comparison. Cancel the endpoint inverses to prove the diagonal and trace squares. Apply integration_transport separately to both original integration identities and the frame source squares. Package the constructed arrows and proved identities as a Diagram and the proved squares as ScalarCompatibility.

Apply diagonalUniformizer_finiteNormalization to the constructed diagram and scalar compatibility. It supplies the three finite realizations, projection-normalized quotient lines, and finite Cartier/trace comparison at exponent l^(n+1). Insert these into QuotientCompatibility with r=n and the given finiteness, annihilation, and invertibility witnesses.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), explicit scalar transport of arrows and integration identities, followed by finite normalization

theorem diagonalCoefficient_uniformizerFiniteComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (hcompletion : DiagonalCompletionSpec l (diagonalSurface Y) D)
    (hsystem : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec l Y hY D)
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (hδ : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (family : Family l Y) (reference : Reference l Y δ family)
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ)
    (hfinite : Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)))
    (hA : ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) = 0)
    (hYpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (hWpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤)))
    (rootsP : FiniteRoots (ProjectiveLine Y) (l ^ (n + 1)))
    (rootsW : FiniteRoots (diagonalSurface Y) (l ^ (n + 1))) :
    ∃ d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
        Y (quotientLine l E π n),
      Nonempty (ScalarCompatibility (quotientMap l E π n) Y
        (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (quotientLine l E π n)
        (quotientLineMap l E π n) (family.integral E) d) ∧
      QuotientCompatibility l Y E π n d
